question: Where and by what means are the subsequent offerings to be made?
premises: Offerings are directed to the directions.
Offerings are also directed to the intermediate directions.
Specific mantra sequences will be stated.
inference: Offerings are to be made in the directions and intermediate directions using the mantra sequences to be stated.
plain_english: Likewise, in the directions and intermediate directions, offerings are made with the mantra sequences that will be described.
